packMeta.name: Aokie Receptionist (SoftN + Forms)
packMeta.description: Turnkey AI phone & front-desk console: two-pane live call console with structured Caller/AI transcripts, two-pane SMS inbox with AI draft approval, appointments & orders desk, follow-up tasks queue, callers CRM, Bluetooth dongle hardware events log and AI persona/routing configuration. Includes the full-stack SoftN application plus 10 schema-matched FormLogic forms & management charts sharing the same live SQLite database.
